title: Configurando horários e capacidade para receber reservas
description: Verifies that an administrator can define operating hours and simultaneous box capacity and save the agenda settings successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the agenda configuration page
Define the operating days and hours
Set the simultaneous box capacity
Save the agenda settings
Verify the agenda configuration is saved and ready for bookings

title: Fazendo um agendamento público com sucesso
description: Verifies that a customer can choose an available service, pick an available date and time, enter details, and complete a public booking successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the public booking page
Choose a service
Select an available date
Select an available time slot
Fill in the customer details
Confirm the booking
Verify the reservation is registered successfully

title: Concluir check-in com vistoria e aceite completo
description: Verifica que um atendente consegue registrar a entrada do veículo com vistoria, avarias, assinatura e termo aceito, finalizando o check-in com sucesso.

steps.description: Navigate to the check-in page
Register vehicle conditions with photos
Mark any pre-existing damage that applies
Capture the customer's digital signature
Accept the responsibility term
Complete the check-in
Verify the check-in is completed successfully
Verify the vehicle entry is recorded

title: Mostrando o tutorial de boas-vindas para uma nova oficina
description: Verifies that a new tenant sees the onboarding welcome modal with the tutorial video on first access.

steps.description: Navigate to the application home page
Verify the welcome onboarding modal is displayed
Verify the tutorial video content is available

title: Cadastrando um novo serviço com tempo e preços por porte
description: Verifies that an administrator can create a new service, define execution time and base prices by vehicle size, and save it to the catalog.
category: Catálogo de Serviços e Matriz de Preços

steps.description: Navigate to the service management page
Start creating a new service
Fill in the service name
Fill in the execution time
Define the base prices by vehicle size
Save the service
Verify the new service appears in the catalog

title: Record receivables expenses and commission
description: Verifica que o usuário financeiro consegue lançar recebíveis, despesas e comissão vinculada a um atendimento, com os movimentos refletidos no caixa.

steps.description: Navigate to the finance area
Register an account receivable
Record an operational expense
Register a commission linked to a service appointment
Verify the financial entries are listed
Verify the cash flow reflects the new movements

title: Review cash flow and balance after transactions
description: Verifica que, após registrar movimentações financeiras, o usuário consegue consultar o fluxo de caixa e conferir o saldo atualizado.

steps.description: Navigate to the finance area
Record financial movements for the period
Open the cash flow view
Review the balance summary
Verify the cash flow entries are displayed
Verify the balance summary is updated

title: Create a proposal with services and discounts
description: Verifica que o gestor consegue montar uma proposta com itens, aplicar descontos e revisar o total calculado antes de gerar o documento.

steps.description: Navigate to the proposals area
Create a new proposal
Add services and items to the proposal
Apply a discount to the proposal
Review the calculated total
Verify the proposal total is displayed
Verify the proposal is ready for document generation

title: Bloqueando um horário indisponível no agendamento público
description: Verifies that a customer cannot confirm a booking for an unavailable time and is prompted to choose another option.

steps.description: Navigate to the public booking page
Choose a service
Select an unavailable time slot
Attempt to confirm the booking
Verify a time unavailable message is displayed
Verify the booking is not completed

title: Generate and share a proposal PDF
description: Verifica que uma proposta concluída pode ser gerada em PDF e compartilhada com o cliente dentro do fluxo esperado.

steps.description: Navigate to the proposals area
Open an existing proposal or create a new one
Generate the proposal PDF
Share the document with the customer
Verify a proposal PDF is available
Verify a sharing confirmation is visible

Start the lesson video

Register vehicle conditions with photos
Accept the responsibility term
Attempt to complete the check-in without capturing the customer's digital signature

Verify the check-in remains incomplete
